title: Kinematic Sliding L-Mold Casting
discipline: Two-Part Hand Mold Kinematics · Liquid Alloy Hydrodynamics · Antimony Expansion · Gutenberg Standardization
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the mechanical kinematics of Gutenberg's two-part sliding L-shaped hand mold, proving that variable horizontal set-width clamping combined with hydrodynamic flash-free casting established the true mechanical foundation of interchangeable mass-production typography?
